definitions.gloss: drink diluted with hot water (esp. shochu)
definitions.explanation: An alcoholic drink, most often shochu, mixed with hot water; also the practice of diluting a drink this way. Popular in colder months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered shochu with hot water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
examples.english: On a cold night, a hot-water mix warms the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ→引き立つ：25243_hikitatsu⟧。
examples.english: This shochu's aroma comes out beautifully when mixed with hot water.

notes:
A drink — most often ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧ (shochu) — diluted with hot water, popular in colder months. Formed from ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧ (hot water) + {割|わ}り (dilution).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}り: shochu with hot water
- お{湯|ゆ}{割|わ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mix with hot water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水割|みずわ}り→水割り：16023_mizuwari⟧: a drink diluted with cold water and ice
- ⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧: on the rocks (over ice, undiluted)
